ctx.x: And I was just a thing thing that was on a platform at the finish, but the following week, I was there for two or three weeks, I played a solo, that's when my name was changed, Paul Ash couldn't remember my name. He called me Norvick, hecalled me Norman, and he called meeverything and finally, variety, the day -- view -- reviewed the show the second week, he called me Red Norvo. And that's the way it is.
